elements.text: master and version3 branches are now both updated. There was an additional change in libbitcoin, so if you had already updated server, sorry - need to do it again as of just a minute ago. This is basically two patches that both affect server indexing of address history. P2SH indexing was largely missed, and there was a race that caused infrequent dropping of entries for an addresses with multiple entries in multiple txs of one block. Once the community servers are updated and we have good feedback I'll tag a v3.4. Thanks everyone for the reporting and help!
